intro: Three stages, about 200 hours in all. There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so the order matters: do the missable thing first, then the story, then the checklist.

missable.note: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 (the morning after Down to Earth) counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and disappears once Chapter 1 ends. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one untouched save from just before the final mission — the game has 15 manual slots plus one autosave. Never use cheats on your trophy save: they switch off trophies and saving.

steps: Finish the 5-chapter story and the optional missions as they appear.
Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals through the binoculars as you go — progress already counts toward the checklist.
Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 (the only missable trophy).
Do Race Against Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3 — it is time-sensitive and feeds Strangers & Freaks.
Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter; never use cheats on your trophy save.
stages.title: Stage 1 — Story first

steps: After the credits, open the checklist under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work the checklist at a glance below: it is lenient, closer to 60% true completion.
The only parts that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
You only need 70 of 80 challenges, so skip the hardest ones.
stages.title: Stage 2 — 100% Completion checklist

steps: Finish the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not count, they have their own trophies.
Finish the six side-story finales (Andy, Billy, Kenton, Randy, Tyrone, Bret).
Sweep up the five trophies with no confirmed method yet — they may pop while you play normally.
Earn the last trophies, then the Platinum, Vice Got a Price!, pops.
stages.title: Stage 3 — Strangers & Freaks and cleanup

title: Road to the Platinum
